IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with blonde hair pulled
back into loose strands wears a sheer dark lace
high-neck blouse with long sleeves, layered over a
dark velvet corset with metal grommets and a
central lace-up front. Layered chain necklaces with
a round pendant sit at her throat. Her expression is
calm and serious. Soft, diffused forest light with
blurred green foliage and fallen leaves. Palette of
deep violet, forest green, and muted gold. Dark
romantic and earthy, in the style of a moody forest
editorial.
